Five merged pull requests since 2026-04-14 added or removed a line containing `hasPrivilege` under `api/src/main/java/org/openmrs`. Dates are the commit dates on the default branch, which I'm treating as the merge dates. The list is partial: I checked the diffs of the candidate commits by path, not every one of the 73 commits in the window.

| Merged | PR | Ticket | What changed |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-08 | #6544 | TRUNK-6799 | Added `OpenmrsAuthorizationManagerFactory`, whose `holdsPrivilege` calls `Context.hasPrivilege(privilege)` (`a69b14a`). |
| 2026-10-13 | #6668 | TRUNK-6802 | Removed `if (Context.hasPrivilege(privilege)) {` from `OpenmrsPermissionEvaluator` (`cb6cda4`). |
| 2026-07-24 | #6383 | TRUNK-6712 | Replaced the `hasPrivilege` body in `UserContext` and added the two-argument overload (`1b5421a`). |
| 2026-10-01 | #6598 | TRUNK-6707 | Added `Context.hasPrivilege(gp.getViewPrivilege(), false)` in `AdministrationServiceImpl` (`07e8ea0`). |
| 2026-06-18 | #6186 | none in the subject | Added `Context.hasPrivilege(PrivilegeConstants.GET_ALERTS)` in `AlertServiceImpl` (`f5c0350`). |

- **Not a PR:** `3310bc1` ("TRUNK-6705: Follow-up: Re-add null privilege check", 2026-08-26) added a test line calling `userContext.hasPrivilege("Privilege1")` in `UserContextTest`. It is a direct commit with no linked pull request, so I left it out of the answer.
- **Checked, no `hasPrivilege` line:** `0340ada` (#6672), `4d92b49` (#6483, Daemon file only), `a48d5d8` (#6508), `22a4bae`, `7b9487c` (#6671), `befcc05` (#6377), `2c9b2ee` (#6627, `RolePrivilegeCache` and `UserContext` only), `83411b2` (#6654, JobRunr file only), and the `AuthorizationAdvice` and `PrivilegeNamingAuthorizationManager` parts of `5eb8cba` (#6674).
- **Not checked:** the other files in `5eb8cba` and `2c9b2ee`, and `50810cf` (#6318), `f46e57d` (#6324), `d8fe136` (#6317) and `9c51524` (#6315), which I judged unlikely to touch the line but did not diff.

Falkon needed the full name `github.com/openmrs/openmrs-core`; the bare name was rejected. I could not read the saved 57 KB diff for `5eb8cba` because its directory is permission-denied.
